read_and_write_order: Read only results/ai/inputs/classes.csv and results/ai/inputs/package_counts.json for the initial hypothesis; inspect full class-name lists grouped by package.
Wrote results/ai/initial_hypothesis.md before reading either dependency file or package_documentation.txt.
Read the remaining three permitted evidence files; inspect package documentation and direct class/package relationship summaries.
Choose one final responsibility partition by semantic judgment; materialize assignment.csv and architecture.json; write the complete response.md.
Read only the newly written assignment.csv and architecture.json for artifact coverage/count validation against classes.csv; write activity.json.

Read the newly generated response.md and activity.json for a final Markdown table-format check. The check found no literal newline separator defect, so no response or partition change was needed; updated this activity record.
tools_and_methods: functions.exec orchestrated tools.exec_command in the specified working directory. The prompt was read with cat; subsequent data reading, summarization, writing, and validation used Python standard-library pathlib, csv, collections, json, and hashlib.
Names/package counts informed the separately recorded qualitative hypothesis. Package documentation and direct graph adjacency informed refinement.

Used raw class/package edge counts and named class relationships as descriptive evidence; inspected zero/single-incident-edge types for preservation. Did not calculate normalized graph measures or architecture-quality scores.

Applied reviewer-selected explicit memberships for the multimap/multiset, table, interval, service, synchronization/control, and URL-escaper families, with declared package defaults for remaining capabilities. No clustering algorithm was run.
Validated class coverage, unique ownership, known cluster IDs, exact module counts, graph endpoint/duplicate consistency, and correspondence of the supplied package aggregates to the class graph.
No external browsing, documentation-link following, source-code reading, baseline inspection, or metric-code execution was performed. No subreviewer was spawned for this controlled recovery turn.
